RAY remains the strongest Solana application-layer watch for tokenized-equity utilization. It is around $1.49 with strong short-term price, fee and revenue momentum, but no fresh independently funded historically selective wallet cohort was verified; after the large monthly run, that missing leg still blocks a prospective paper entry.

DRV remains a high-momentum options-market candidate with very high turnover and a fresh local all-time-high print, but the previously identified supply/governance and wallet-quality caveats remain unresolved. No structural or wallet confirmation sufficient to convert the watch into a paper buy surfaced this run.

The fresh move does not supply a new independent selective-wallet or value-capture confirmation, so the existing roughly 5% position is held rather than chased.

A newly reported large ZEC derivatives/order wallet is not treated as a fourth independent spot accumulator because much of the activity consists of leveraged exposure and unfilled buy orders. ZEC remains at the normal 7.5% non-core cap with no add.
